q1.explanationZh: weapon 名词“武器”，a nuclear weapon“核武器”；注意 ea 读 /e/。

q2.explanationZh: wear 表示“穿着；戴着”的状态，如 wear glasses“戴眼镜”；过去式 wore。

q3.explanationZh: weather“天气”是不可数名词；注意和 whether（是否）区分拼写。

q4.explanationZh: weather（天气）+ man（人）= weatherman“气象预报员”，复数 weathermen。

q5.explanationZh: weave 动词“编；织”，to weave a mat“织席子”。

q6.explanationZh: web 名词“蜘蛛网；网络”，a spider’s web“蜘蛛网”。

q7.explanationZh: web（网络）+ site（地点）= website“网站”。

q8.explanationZh: wedding 名词“婚礼”，注意双写 d：wed-ding。

q9.explanationZh: weed 名词“杂草”，动词“除草”，如 weeding the flower beds。

q10.explanationZh: week 名词“周，星期”，last week“上周”。

q11.explanationZh: week（周）+ day（天）= weekday“工作日”，on weekdays“在工作日”。

q12.explanationZh: week（周）+ end（末尾）= weekend“周末”，at the weekend“在周末”。

q13.explanationZh: week 加 -ly 构成 weekly，可作形容词、副词和名词（周刊）。

q14.explanationZh: weep“哭泣”，过去式和过去分词是 wept。

q15.explanationZh: weigh 动词“称重；重若干”，名词是 weight；注意 -eigh 读 /eɪ/。

q16.explanationZh: weigh 的名词 weight“重量；体重”，lose weight“减肥”。

q17.explanationZh: weird“奇怪的”，拼写是 e 在 i 前：w-e-i-r-d。

q18.explanationZh: welcome 可作动词、名词“欢迎”和形容词“受欢迎的”，注意只有一个 l。

q19.explanationZh: welfare 名词“福利”，wel（好）+ fare，只有一个 l。

q20.explanationZh: well 作副词“好”、形容词“健康的”，另有同形词 well 名词“井”。

q21.explanationZh: well（很）+ known（被知道的）= well-known“有名的”，中间有连字符。

q22.explanationZh: west 名词、形容词“西；西方（的）”，from the west“从西方”。

q23.explanationZh: west 加 -ern 构成形容词 western“西方的”。

q24.explanationZh: wet 形容词“湿的”，也可作名词和动词，反义词是 dry。

q25.explanationZh: wet（湿的）+ land（土地）= wetland“湿地”。

q26.explanationZh: whale“鲸”，注意 wh 开头，读 /weɪl/。

q27.explanationZh: what 疑问代词“什么”，也可引导名词性从句。

q28.explanationZh: what + ever = whatever“无论什么”，可引导名词性从句和让步状语从句。

q29.explanationZh: wheat“小麦”，a field of wheat“一块麦田”。

q30.explanationZh: wheel 名词“轮子”，动词“转动”；注意 wh 开头，ee 读 /iː/。

q31.explanationZh: when 疑问副词“什么时候，何时”。

q32.explanationZh: when + ever = whenever“无论何时；每当”，引导状语从句。

q35.explanationZh: spider’s 是名词所有格“蜘蛛的”，a spider’s web“蜘蛛网”。

accept: be welcome to do sth./to sth.

q36.explanationZh: welcome 作形容词“可随意的”：be welcome to do sth.“可随意做某事”，be welcome to sth.“可随意取用某物”。

q37.explanationZh: seek“谋求”+ welfare“福利”：seek the people’s welfare，手册写作 seek welfare for the people。

q38.explanationZh: as well“也，又”，一般放在句末。

q39.explanationZh: as well as“除……之外（也）”，连接两个并列成分。

q40.explanationZh: hunt“捕猎”+ whales（鲸，用复数）：hunt whales。

q41.explanationZh: a field of ...“一块……田”，wheat 不可数：a field of wheat。

q42.explanationZh: at the weekend“在周末”（英式），美式也说 on the weekend。

q43.explanationZh: receive a cold welcome“受到冷淡的欢迎”，即“受到冷遇”。

q44.explanationZh: what ... for? 表示“为什么，为何目的”。

q45.explanationZh: What about ...? 用来询问意见或提出建议“……怎么样？”

q46.explanationZh: when it comes to“当谈到……”，这里的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

q47.explanationZh: weekly 形容词“每周的”+ wage“工资”：weekly wage“周薪”。

q48.explanationZh: “不管她穿什么”，whatever 引导让步状语从句，相当于 no matter what。

q49.explanationZh: 听到坏消息时“哭了”，过去的事用过去式；weep 的过去式是 wept。

q50.explanationZh: the West Lake“西湖”，专有名称首字母大写。

q51.explanationZh: while 表示对比，与 dry（干燥的）相对的是 wet“多雨的，潮湿的”。

q52.explanationZh: 名词 wage 前用形容词 weekly“每周的”，weekly wage“周薪”。

q53.explanationZh: “不管你说什么”，Whatever 引导让步状语从句，放在句首要大写。

q54.explanationZh: 与 Chinese（中国的）并列，用形容词 Western“西方的”，指西餐。

q55.explanationZh: wheels 在口语里可指“车子”；买不起车的人只好搭便车，用复数 wheels。

q56.explanationZh: receive a cold welcome“受到冷遇”，a 后接名词 welcome。

q57.explanationZh: It is + 形容词 + that ...，猫好像能听懂我们说话，真“奇怪”：weird。

q58.sampleAnswer: Whatever challenges we face, our team will overcome them with strong determination.
references: Whatever challenges we face, our team will overcome them with strong determination.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “无论面对什么挑战”用 Whatever challenges we face，whatever 后可直接接名词；“克服”= overcome。

q59.sampleAnswer: Everyone should do what he thinks right.
references: Everyone should do what he thinks right.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: what 引导宾语从句，相当于“……的事”；think sth. right“认为某事是对的”。

q60.sampleAnswer: An encyclopedia is a well of knowledge.
references: An encyclopedia is a well of knowledge.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: well 作名词“井”，比喻“源泉”：a well of knowledge“知识的源泉”。

q61.sampleAnswer: Whenever he feels happy, he can’t help waving his hands and jumping with joy.
references: Whenever he feels happy, he can’t help waving his hands and jumping with joy.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “每当”= whenever；“情不自禁地做某事”= can’t help doing sth.。

q62.sampleAnswer: This gold medal has not only witnessed the growth and transformation of the athlete, but has also shown the struggle and perseverance of Chinese athletes.
references: This gold medal has not only witnessed the growth and transformation of the athlete, but has also shown the struggle and perseverance of Chinese athletes.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: witness 作动词“见证”；“不仅……而且……”用 not only ... but also ...，用现在完成时。

q63.sampleAnswer: They can see the words on the blackboard clearly, so they don’t have to wear glasses.
references: They can see the words on the blackboard clearly, so they don’t have to wear glasses.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “戴眼镜”= wear glasses；“不需要”= don’t have to。

q64.sampleAnswer: Despite the bad weather, the sports meet we are looking forward to will be held as planned.
references: Despite the bad weather, the sports meet we are looking forward to will be held as planned.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “尽管天气不好”= despite the bad weather；“盼望”= look forward to；“按计划”= as planned。

q65.sampleAnswer: Only when you lose something will you find how precious it is, so you should learn to cherish what you have.
references: Only when you lose something will you find how precious it is, so you should learn to cherish what you have.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “Only + 状语从句”放句首时，主句要部分倒装：will you find；“珍惜”= cherish。

q66.sampleAnswer: The article is worth reading, for it provides not only much information about the course but also a lot of practical websites.
references: The article is worth reading, for it provides not only much information about the course but also a lot of practical websites.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “值得一读”= be worth reading；“网址”用复数 websites；not only ... but also ... 连接两个宾语。

q67.sampleAnswer: Many people prefer to get married on National Day, so you’ll have to reserve the restaurant at least half a year before your daughter’s wedding.
references: Many people prefer to get married on National Day, so you’ll have to reserve the restaurant at least half a year before your daughter’s wedding.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “结婚”= get married，“婚礼”= wedding；“预定”= reserve。
